source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Each **LEAGUES OF VOTANN** **TRANSPORT** unit of yours has **Firebase Control (Aura)**: while one of your **INFANTRY** units with the LEAGUES OF VOTANN keyword sits wholly inside 6" of it, that unit's models' ranged weapons have **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**.

grants.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 1 of 8 sampled ability grants of Detachment rules wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

combat.unresolved: The rule gives its units an aura for other units, which the reading asks about the units that have it.
